_readme: SAMPLE DATA — placeholder text only, not authentic Gitsawe readings. Replace every 'pauline'/'catholic'/'acts'/'psalm'/'gospel' value below with the real scripture citations (and, where your tradition varies the Gospel reading by year, fill in 'gospelByEvangelist' with matthew/mark/luke/john keys) from your church's Gitsawe reference book. Keys under 'fixed' are '<EthiopianMonthId>-<Day>', e.g. '12-2' = Nahase 2. Keys under 'movable' are the same season/feast slugs already used elsewhere in the site's code (see MAJOR_FASTS and calculateBahireHasabMovableFeasts): 'himamat', 'abiy-tsom', 'tinsae', plus any specific movable-feast slug such as 'genna', 'timkat', 'hosanna', 'siklet', 'irget', 'peraklitos', etc. if a given feast has its own distinct Gitsawe reading rather than falling back to the season.
